jam.types.base.boolean module¶

class jam.types.base.boolean.Boolean(value)[source]¶

Bases: Codable, JsonSerde

Boolean type that implements the Codable interface.

Examples:
>>> b = Boolean(True)
>>> bool(b)
True
>>> b.encode()
b'\x01'
>>> Boolean.decode_from(b'\x01')
(Boolean(True), 1)
Parameters:

value (bool)
